payload.criterion: README documents git+ uv tool install for adaptive-artifacts and states PyPI is deferred; repo has no pyproject.toml
payload.verify_command: grep -qiE 'uv tool install' README.md && grep -qiE 'git\+https://github.com/andrewy1n/adaptive-artifacts' README.md && grep -qiE 'PyPI.*(defer|later|not yet|wait)' README.md && ! test -f pyproject.toml
